learning_outcomes.text: Position production activity globally within the company.
Understand the missions and objectives of production activity.
Perceive interactions and dependencies with other departments.
Understand the necessity of communication / synchronization, primarily with support services (Methods, Maintenance, Purchasing/Supply, Quality, HR).

Be introduced to techniques, methods, and tools (organizational, technical, and IT) necessary for effective and sustainable production management at different decision horizons (long-term strategic to short-term operational).
Understand the importance of coherent management of company data, information, and knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Generalities on production management (concepts, challenges, flows...)
Decision levels and management techniques (MRP / MRPII)
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
